sources.snippet: This is a trained model of a RecurrentPPO agent playing CarRacing-v0 using the stable-baselines3 library and the RL Zoo. The RL Zoo is a training framework for Stable Baselines3 reinforcement learning agents, with hyperparameter optimization and pre-trained agents included.

sources.title: PPO — Stable Baselines3 2.9.1a1 documentation
sources.snippet: PPO The Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm combines ideas from A2C (having multiple workers) and TRPO (it uses a trust region to improve the actor). The main idea is that after an update, the new policy should be not too far from the old policy. For that, ppo uses clipping to avoid too large update.
